+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	caCert, serverCert, serverKey, err := redisTLSCertificates()
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+
+	redisSrv := client.Container().
+		From("redis:alpine").
+		WithNewFile("/tls/ca.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: caCert}).
+		WithNewFile("/tls/server.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: serverCert}).
+		WithNewFile("/tls/server.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: serverKey}).
+		WithExposedPort(6379).
+		WithExec([]string{
+			"redis-server",
+			"--port", "0",
+			"--tls-port", "6379",
+			"--tls-cert-file", "/tls/server.crt",
+			"--tls-key-file", "/tls/server.key",
+			"--tls-ca-cert-file", "/tls/ca.crt",
+			"--tls-auth-clients", "no",
+		}).
+		AsService()
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redisSrv).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_PORT", "6379").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_BYTES", caCert)
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}
+
+func redisTLSCertificates() (caCert, serverCert, serverKey string, err error) {
+	now := time.Now()
+	caKey, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+
+	caTemplate := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "Flipt Redis integration CA"},
+		NotBefore:             now.Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:              now.Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+	}
+	caDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, caTemplate, caTemplate, &caKey.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+
+	serverKeyPair, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+	serverTemplate := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber: big.NewInt(2),
+		Subject:      pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis"},
+		DNSNames:     []string{"redis"},
+		NotBefore:    now.Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:     now.Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:     x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+		ExtKeyUsage:  []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+	}
+	serverDER, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, serverTemplate, caTemplate, &serverKeyPair.PublicKey, caKey)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+
+	serverKeyDER, err := x509.MarshalECPrivateKey(serverKeyPair)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", "", "", err
+	}
+
+	caCert = string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: caDER}))
+	serverCert = string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: serverDER}))
+	serverKey = string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "EC PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: serverKeyDER}))
+	return caCert, serverCert, serverKey, nil
+}

index 0000000..a465761

@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient creates a Redis client using the provided connection configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, errors.New("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS, //nolint:gosec // explicitly configured by the operator
+		}
+
+		if !cfg.InsecureSkipTLS && (cfg.CaCertBytes != "" || cfg.CaCertPath != "") {
+			caCert := []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+			if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+				var err error
+				caCert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+				if err != nil {
+					return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+				}
+			}
+
+			rootCAs, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
+			if err != nil || rootCAs == nil {
+				rootCAs = x509.NewCertPool()
+			}
+			if ok := rootCAs.AppendCertsFromPEM(caCert); !ok {
+				return nil, errors.New("parsing redis CA certificate: no certificates found")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = rootCAs
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,129 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"crypto/x509/pkix"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"math/big"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLSConfig(t *testing.T) {
+	caCert := testCACertificate(t)
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name  string
+		cfg   config.RedisCacheConfig
+		check func(t *testing.T, clientTLS *tls.Config)
+	}{
+		{
+			name: "TLS disabled",
+			cfg:  config.RedisCacheConfig{},
+			check: func(t *testing.T, clientTLS *tls.Config) {
+				assert.Nil(t, clientTLS)
+			},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "system certificate authorities",
+			cfg:  config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true},
+			check: func(t *testing.T, clientTLS *tls.Config) {
+				require.NotNil(t, clientTLS)
+				assert.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), clientTLS.MinVersion)
+				assert.Nil(t, clientTLS.RootCAs)
+				assert.False(t, clientTLS.InsecureSkipVerify)
+			},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "inline certificate authority",
+			cfg:  config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: string(caCert)},
+			check: func(t *testing.T, clientTLS *tls.Config) {
+				require.NotNil(t, clientTLS.RootCAs)
+				assert.Contains(t, clientTLS.RootCAs.Subjects(), caCertificateSubject(t, caCert))
+			},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "skip certificate verification",
+			cfg:  config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, InsecureSkipTLS: true},
+			check: func(t *testing.T, clientTLS *tls.Config) {
+				require.NotNil(t, clientTLS)
+				assert.True(t, clientTLS.InsecureSkipVerify)
+				assert.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), clientTLS.MinVersion)
+				assert.Nil(t, clientTLS.RootCAs)
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			client, err := NewClient(tt.cfg)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			defer client.Close()
+			tt.check(t, client.Options().TLSConfig)
+		})
+	}
+
+	t.Run("certificate authority file", func(t *testing.T) {
+		caPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.crt")
+		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(caPath, caCert, 0600))
+
+		client, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+			RequireTLS: true,
+			CaCertPath: caPath,
+		})
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		defer client.Close()
+		assert.Contains(t, client.Options().TLSConfig.RootCAs.Subjects(), caCertificateSubject(t, caCert))
+	})
+
+	t.Run("invalid certificate authority", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: "invalid"})
+		require.EqualError(t, err, "parsing redis CA certificate: no certificates found")
+	})
+
+	t.Run("both certificate authority sources", func(t *testing.T) {
+		_, err := NewClient(config.RedisCacheConfig{
+			CaCertBytes: "inline",
+			CaCertPath:  "path",
+		})
+		require.EqualError(t, err, "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	})
+}
+
+func testCACertificate(t *testing.T) []byte {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "Redis test CA"},
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Minute),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
+}
+
+func caCertificateSubject(t *testing.T, caCert []byte) []byte {
+	t.Helper()
+	block, _ := pem.Decode(caCert)
+	require.NotNil(t, block)
+	cert, err := x509.ParseCertificate(block.Bytes)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return cert.RawSubject
+}
